resources.string: Try the keyboard: opens a text box
Show or hide the theme preview
That picture could not be read.
The picture goes behind the keys, the emoji panel and the clipboard panel. Fade makes it lighter or darker so the letters stay readable. Lower the key opacity to see the picture through the keys.
Choose which part of the picture shows, for portrait and landscape

Drag the picture to move it, pinch to zoom. The bright frame is your keyboard, the dimmed part is cut off. Portrait and landscape are set separately, and so are the main keyboard and the small windows (voice, emoji, clipboard): they can show different parts of the picture.
Add a theme somebody shared with you
No theme found in that text.
You have too many themes. Delete one first.
Send it to a friend as text
Send it to a friend as text. The picture is not included.
There is no app to share with.

My Monsoon Script keyboard theme “%1$s”.
To use it: open Monsoon Script, then Appearance, then Themes, tap Import a theme and paste this text.

%2$s
A thin line around every key
A soft shadow under the keys
Text size in the suggestion bar
Type 16+8 and the answer shows up: \"= 24\" adds it after, \"\u2192 24\" replaces what you typed. Works offline.

It understands + - * / x \u00D7 \u00F7 ^, brackets, 20% of 150, 150+10%, 10 mod 3, 5!, \u221A, pi, sin cos tan, ln log, round floor ceil, min max avg, gcd lcm, ncr npr, 0xFF, 255 to hex, 5 km in miles and 98.6 f to c. Things that look like a date, a range or a phone number (12/5, 5-10) are left alone: add = (5-10=) or spaces (5 - 10) to calculate them.
Use the notch area in landscape
The keyboard background (and your picture) also fills the strip next to the camera hole when the phone is on its side. The keys stay clear of it. Whether this works depends on your phone.
Small windows are voice typing, emoji and clipboard. They show the picture too, with their own blur and their own position (see Position and zoom).
